title: Application of Order I Rule 8
description: Modification to the application of Order I Rule 8 of the First Schedule to the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908

content.general_rule: The provisions of Order I Rule 8 of the First Schedule to the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 apply
content.exception: Subject to the modification that every reference therein to a suit or decree shall be construed as a reference to a complaint or the order of the District Commission thereon
